    rwa [← Matrix.charpoly_toLin', ← Module.End.hasEigenvalue_iff_isRoot_charpoly]

theorem iso_derivative_primitive_comp_eq_one
    (f : PowerSeries ℚ)
    (c : ℚ)
    (num den p q : Polynomial ℚ)
    (hf0 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 f = c)
    (hden_eval : den.eval c ≠ 0)
    (hnum_eval : num.eval c ≠ 0)
    (hpoly_ode :
      PowerSeries.derivativeFun f *
          den.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f =
        num.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f)
    (hq_eval : q.eval c ≠ 0)
    (hcross :
      (p.derivative * q - p * q.derivative) * num = den * q ^ 2) :
    PowerSeries.derivativeFun
        (p.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f *
          (q.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f)⁻¹) =
      1 := by
  let F : PowerSeries ℚ := PowerSeries.derivativeFun f
  let D : PowerSeries ℚ := den.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f
  let N : PowerSeries ℚ := num.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f
  let P : PowerSeries ℚ := p.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f
  let Q : PowerSeries ℚ := q.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f
  let P' : PowerSeries ℚ := p.derivative.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f
  let Q' : PowerSeries ℚ := q.derivative.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f
  have hD0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff D ≠ 0 :=
    iso_coeff_zero_eval₂_ne_zero_of_eval_initial_ne_zero den f c hf0 hden_eval
  have hQ0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff Q ≠ 0 :=
    iso_coeff_zero_eval₂_ne_zero_of_eval_initial_ne_zero q f c hf0 hq_eval
  have hcross_eval :
      (P' * Q - P * Q') * N = D * Q ^ 2 := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun a : Polynomial ℚ => a.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f) hcross
    simpa [P, Q, P', Q', N, D, map_mul, map_sub, map_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_mul,
      Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_pow, mul_assoc] using h
  have hode : F * D = N := by
    simpa [F, D, N] using hpoly_ode
  have hFD :
      (P' * Q - P * Q') * F = Q ^ 2 := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (show D ≠ 0 by
      intro hDzero
      exact hD0 (by simp [D, hDzero]))
    calc
      ((P' * Q - P * Q') * F) * D
          = (P' * Q - P * Q') * (F * D) := by ring
      _ = (P' * Q - P * Q') * N := by rw [hode]
      _ = D * Q ^ 2 := hcross_eval
      _ = Q ^ 2 * D := by ring
  have hderiv :
      PowerSeries.derivativeFun (P * Q⁻¹) =
        (P' * Q - P * Q') * F * Q⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    have hPder : PowerSeries.derivativeFun P = P' * F := by
      simpa [P, P', F] using iso_derivative_eval₂_polynomial p f
    have hQder : PowerSeries.derivativeFun Q = Q' * F := by
      simpa [Q, Q', F] using iso_derivative_eval₂_polynomial q f
    have hQinvder :
        PowerSeries.derivativeFun (Q⁻¹) =
          -(Q⁻¹) ^ 2 * PowerSeries.derivativeFun Q := by
      simpa [PowerSeries.derivative] using (PowerSeries.derivative_inv' (R := ℚ) Q)
    calc
      PowerSeries.derivativeFun (P * Q⁻¹)
          = P * PowerSeries.derivativeFun Q⁻¹ + Q⁻¹ * PowerSeries.derivativeFun P := by
            rw [PowerSeries.derivativeFun_mul]
            simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      _ = P * (-(Q⁻¹) ^ 2 * PowerSeries.derivativeFun Q) +
            Q⁻¹ * PowerSeries.derivativeFun P := by
            rw [hQinvder]
      _ = P * (-(Q⁻¹) ^ 2 * (Q' * F)) + Q⁻¹ * (P' * F) := by
            rw [hPder, hQder]
      _ = (P' * Q - P * Q') * F * Q⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
            have hQcancel : Q * Q⁻¹ = 1 := PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel Q hQ0
            have hQcancel' : Q⁻¹ * Q = 1 := PowerSeries.inv_mul_cancel Q hQ0
            have haux : Q⁻¹ * F * P' = Q⁻¹ ^ 2 * F * P' * Q := by
              calc
                Q⁻¹ * F * P' = (Q⁻¹ * Q) * (Q⁻¹ * F * P') := by
                  rw [hQcancel']
                  ring
                _ = Q⁻¹ ^ 2 * F * P' * Q := by ring
            ring_nf
            rw [haux]
  rw [hderiv]
  calc
    (P' * Q - P * Q') * F * Q⁻¹ ^ 2
        = Q ^ 2 * Q⁻¹ ^ 2 := by rw [hFD]
    _ = (Q * Q⁻¹) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel Q hQ0]
      ring

/-- Formal separated-variable integration: the rational primitive `p/q`,
composed with a solution of the autonomous equation, has derivative `1`, hence
is affine in the independent variable. -/
theorem iso_separated_primitive_affine_identity
    (f : PowerSeries ℚ)
    (c : ℚ)
    (num den p q : Polynomial ℚ)
    (hf0 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 f = c)
    (hden_eval : den.eval c ≠ 0)
    (hnum_eval : num.eval c ≠ 0)
    (hpoly_ode :
      PowerSeries.derivativeFun f *
          den.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f =
        num.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f)
    (hq_eval : q.eval c ≠ 0)
    (hprimitive :
      algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ)
            (p.derivative * q - p * q.derivative) /
          (algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) q) ^ 2 =
        algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) den /
          algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) num) :
    ∃ r : ℚ,
      p.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f *
          (q.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f)⁻¹ =
        PowerSeries.X + PowerSeries.C r := by
  have hnum_ne : num ≠ 0 := by
    intro hnum_zero
    exact hnum_eval (by simp [hnum_zero])
  have hq_ne : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hq_zero
    exact hq_eval (by simp [hq_zero])
  have hcross :
      (p.derivative * q - p * q.derivative) * num = den * q ^ 2 :=
    iso_ratfunc_primitive_cross_multiply num den p q hnum_ne hq_ne hprimitive
  let s : PowerSeries ℚ :=
    p.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f *
      (q.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f)⁻¹
  have hs_deriv : PowerSeries.derivativeFun s = 1 := by
    simpa [s] using
      iso_derivative_primitive_comp_eq_one
        f c num den p q hf0 hden_eval hnum_eval hpoly_ode hq_eval hcross
  refine ⟨PowerSeries.coeff 0 s, ?_⟩
  exact iso_powerSeries_eq_X_add_C_of_derivative_one s hs_deriv

/-- Concrete denominator clearing for the shifted primitive identity.  This
does not introduce the existential witnesses; it proves the exact equality
used after choosing `p' = p - C r * q` and `q' = q`. -/
theorem iso_clear_shifted_primitive_identity
    (f : PowerSeries ℚ)
    (c : ℚ)
    (p q : Polynomial ℚ)
    (r : ℚ)
    (hf0 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 f = c)
    (hq_eval : q.eval c ≠ 0)
    (haffine :
      p.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f *
          (q.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f)⁻¹ =
        PowerSeries.X + PowerSeries.C r) :
    PowerSeries.X * q.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f -
        (p - Polynomial.C r * q).eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f =
      0 := by
  let P : PowerSeries ℚ := p.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f
  let Q : PowerSeries ℚ := q.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f
  have hQ0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff Q ≠ 0 := by
    have hconst :
        PowerSeries.constantCoeff
            (q.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f) =
          q.eval (PowerSeries.coeff 0 f) := by
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
      rw [Polynomial.eval]
      change PowerSeries.constantCoeff
          (q.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f) =
        q.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℚ) (PowerSeries.constantCoeff f)
      have h :=
        (Polynomial.hom_eval₂ (p := q)
          (f := algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ))
          (g := PowerSeries.constantCoeff)
          (x := f))
      simpa using h
    change PowerSeries.constantCoeff
        (q.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f) ≠ 0
    rw [hconst, hf0]
    exact hq_eval
  have hP : P = (PowerSeries.X + PowerSeries.C r) * Q := by
    calc
      P = P * (Q⁻¹ * Q) := by rw [PowerSeries.inv_mul_cancel Q hQ0, mul_one]
      _ = (P * Q⁻¹) * Q := by ring
      _ = (PowerSeries.X + PowerSeries.C r) * Q := by
        rw [show P * Q⁻¹ = PowerSeries.X + PowerSeries.C r by simpa [P, Q] using haffine]
  change PowerSeries.X * Q -
      (p - Polynomial.C r * q).eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f = 0
  have hshift :
      (p - Polynomial.C r * q).eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f =
        P - PowerSeries.C r * Q := by
    simp [P, Q]
  rw [hshift, hP]
  ring

theorem iso_lemma1
    (f : PowerSeries ℚ)
    (c : ℚ)
    (num den p q : Polynomial ℚ)
    (hf0 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 f = c)
    (hden_eval : den.eval c ≠ 0)
    (hnum_eval : num.eval c ≠ 0)
    (hpoly_ode :
      PowerSeries.derivativeFun f *
          den.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f =
        num.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries ℚ)) f)

    (hprimitive :
      algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ)
            (p.derivative * q - p * q.derivative) /
          (algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) q) ^ 2 =
        algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) den /
          algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) num) :

      q' ≠ 0 ∧

    iso_separated_primitive_affine_identity

  have hq_ne : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hq_zero
    exact hq_eval (by simp [hq_zero])
  refine ⟨p - Polynomial.C r * q, q, hq_ne, ?_⟩
  exact iso_clear_shifted_primitive_identity f c p q r hf0 hq_eval haffine

/-- A choice globally maximizes an objective. -/
def IsGlobalMax {X α : Type*} [Preorder α] (g : X → α) (x : X) : Prop :=

/-- Strong set order (Veinott order) on sets in a lattice. -/
def StrongSetLE
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] (A B : Set X) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ B → x ⊓ y ∈ A ∧ x ⊔ y ∈ B

-- `ParametricArgmaxNonempty` or the witness lemmas below.

/-- Anchor: on singleton sets, the strong set order reduces to the underlying

theorem anchor_StrongSetLE_singletons_iff
    {X : Type*} [Lattice X] {a b : X} :
    StrongSetLE ({a} : Set X) ({b} : Set X) ↔ a ≤ b := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hpair := h (by simp : a ∈ ({a} : Set X)) (by simp : b ∈ ({b} : Set X))
    have hjoin : a ⊔ b = b := by
      simpa using hpair.2
    exact sup_eq_right.mp hjoin
  · intro hab x y hx hy
    have hx' : x = a := by simpa using hx
    have hy' : y = b := by simpa using hy
    subst x
    subst y
    constructor
    · simp [inf_eq_left.mpr hab]
    · simp [sup_eq_right.mpr hab]

/-- A set is closed under the lattice meet and join operations. -/
def IsSublatticeSet
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] (A : Set X) : Prop :=
  (∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ A → x ⊓ y ∈ A) ∧
    (∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ A → x ⊔ y ∈ A)

theorem strongSetLE_univ
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] :
    StrongSetLE (Set.univ : Set X) (Set.univ : Set X) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  exact ⟨trivial, trivial⟩

/-- A correspondence is nondecreasing in the strong set order. -/
def StrongSetMonotone
    {X T : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] [Preorder T]
    (G : T → Set X) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃t t' : T⦄, t ≤ t' → StrongSetLE (G t) (G t')

-- @vacuity-scope: StrongSetMonotone: monotonicity alone does not assert that
-- any value `G t` is inhabited.  The nonvacuous Topkis bundle below carries
-- `ParametricArgmaxNonempty` as a field.

theorem strongSetMonotone_const_univ
    {X T : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] [Preorder T] :
    StrongSetMonotone (fun _ : T => (Set.univ : Set X)) := by
  intro t t' htt'
  exact strongSetLE_univ

/-- Strict ordinal single crossing: strict preference for the higher choice is
preserved as the parameter rises.  This is the missing strict half in the
Milgrom--Shannon ordinal condition. -/
def OrdinalStrictSingleCrossing
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]
    (f : X → T → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄ ⦃t t' : T⦄,
    x ≤ x' → t ≤ t' → f x t < f x' t → f x t' < f x' t'

/-- Full ordinal single crossing: both weak and strict crossings are preserved.
This is the workable ordinal complementarity substrate for nonunique Topkis
monotonicity with quasi-supermodularity. -/

    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]
    (f : X → T → α) : Prop :=
  OrdinalSingleCrossing f ∧ OrdinalStrictSingleCrossing f

and strict crossing regions. -/

    (f : X → T → α) :
    OrdinalStrongSingleCrossing f ↔
      (∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄, x ≤ x' → IsUpperSet {t : T | f x t ≤ f x' t}) ∧
        (∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄, x ≤ x' → IsUpperSet {t : T | f x t < f x' t}) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · exact (anchor_OrdinalSingleCrossing_iff_upperSet_sections f).mp h.1
    · intro x x' hxx' t t' htt' ht
      exact h.2 hxx' htt' ht
  · intro h
    constructor
    · exact (anchor_OrdinalSingleCrossing_iff_upperSet_sections f).mpr h.1
    · intro x x' t t' hxx' htt' ht
      exact h.2 hxx' htt' ht

    exact hlt

/-- Topkis recombination for one ordered parameter pair.  This is the core
strong-set proof: meet stays low-optimal and join stays high-optimal. -/
theorem strongSetLE_parametricArgmaxSet
    (F : OrdinalTopkisObjectiveStrong X T α) {t t' : T} (htt' : t ≤ t') :
    StrongSetLE (ParametricArgmaxSet F.objective t)
      (ParametricArgmaxSet F.objective t') := by
  intro x y hx hy
  constructor
  · dsimp [ParametricArgmaxSet, ArgmaxSet, IsGlobalMax] at hx hy ⊢
    intro z
    have hmeet_le_x_t : F.objective (x ⊓ y) t ≤ F.objective x t := hx (x ⊓ y)
    have hx_le_meet_t : F.objective x t ≤ F.objective (x ⊓ y) t := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hlt_t : F.objective (x ⊓ y) t < F.objective x t :=
        lt_of_le_not_ge hmeet_le_x_t hnot
      have hlt_t' : F.objective (x ⊓ y) t' < F.objective x t' :=
        F.strong_single_crossing.2 inf_le_left htt' hlt_t
      have hy_lt_join_t' : F.objective y t' < F.objective (x ⊔ y) t' :=
        (F.quasiSupermodular_section t').2 x y hlt_t'
      exact hy_lt_join_t'.not_ge (hy (x ⊔ y))
    exact le_trans (hx z) hx_le_meet_t
  · dsimp [ParametricArgmaxSet, ArgmaxSet, IsGlobalMax] at hx hy ⊢
    intro z
    have hmeet_le_x_t : F.objective (x ⊓ y) t ≤ F.objective x t := hx (x ⊓ y)
    have hmeet_le_x_t' : F.objective (x ⊓ y) t' ≤ F.objective x t' :=
      F.strong_single_crossing.1 inf_le_left htt' hmeet_le_x_t
    have hy_le_join_t' : F.objective y t' ≤ F.objective (x ⊔ y) t' :=
      (F.quasiSupermodular_section t').1 x y hmeet_le_x_t'
    exact le_trans (hy z) hy_le_join_t'

/-!
# General Topkis / Milgrom--Roberts substrate

Append-only foundational vocabulary for ordinal monotone comparative statics:
single crossing, quasi-supermodularity, argmax existence, and the Veinott strong
set order.  The primitive complementarity notion here is ordinal rather than
cardinal: it is stated only in terms of order comparisons of objective values.

Definition trial notes:
* Single crossing candidate A, an implication between weak preference
  comparisons as the parameter rises, is selected as `OrdinalSingleCrossing`.
  It proves a Mathlib anchor as upper-set closure of crossing regions.
* Single crossing candidate B, real-valued increasing differences, is retained
  only as the cardinal sufficient condition `IncreasingDifferences`.
* Single crossing candidate C, derivative/cross-partial nonnegativity, is
  rejected because the target allows arbitrary ordered parameters and choices.
* Quasi-supermodularity candidate A, the weak+strict Topkis ordinal implication,
  is selected as `QuasiSupermodular`; constants and cardinal supermodularity are
  sanity instances.
* Quasi-supermodularity candidate B, the cardinal inequality, is too strong for
  the general theorem and is kept only as a sufficient condition lemma.
* Strong set order candidate A, the unbundled Veinott relation on `Set X`, is
  selected because it proves the singleton anchor to the element order.
-/

/-- Cardinal increasing differences, retained as a sufficient condition for the
ordinal single-crossing primitive. -/
def IncreasingDifferences
    {X T : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] (f : X → T → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄ ⦃t t' : T⦄,
    x ≤ x' → t ≤ t' → f x' t - f x t ≤ f x' t' - f x t'

/-- Ordinal single crossing: if the higher choice is weakly better at a lower
parameter, it remains weakly better at any higher parameter. -/
def OrdinalSingleCrossing
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]
    (f : X → T → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄ ⦃t t' : T⦄,
    x ≤ x' → t ≤ t' → f x t ≤ f x' t → f x t' ≤ f x' t'

/-- Anchor: single crossing says exactly that, for each ordered choice pair,
the parameter set where the higher choice is weakly preferred is a Mathlib
upper set. -/
theorem anchor_OrdinalSingleCrossing_iff_upperSet_sections
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]
    (f : X → T → α) :
    OrdinalSingleCrossing f ↔
      ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄, x ≤ x' → IsUpperSet {t : T | f x t ≤ f x' t} := by
  constructor
  · intro h x x' hxx'
    intro t t' htt' ht
    exact h hxx' htt' ht
  · intro h x x' t t' hxx' htt' ht
    exact h hxx' htt' ht

theorem ordinalSingleCrossing_const
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α] (a : α) :
    OrdinalSingleCrossing (fun _ : X => fun _ : T => a) := by
  intro x x' t t' hxx' htt' hle
  exact le_rfl

/-- Cardinal increasing differences imply the ordinal single-crossing property
for real-valued objectives. -/
theorem increasingDifferences_to_ordinalSingleCrossing
    {X T : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T]
    {f : X → T → ℝ} (h_inc : IncreasingDifferences f) :
    OrdinalSingleCrossing f := by
  intro x x' t t' hxx' htt' hle
  have hdiff : f x' t - f x t ≤ f x' t' - f x t' := h_inc hxx' htt'
  linarith

/-- Ordinal quasi-supermodularity on a lattice.  The weak implication gives
join optimality; the strict implication rules out losing optimality at the
meet. -/
def QuasiSupermodular
    {X α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] [Preorder α]
    (g : X → α) : Prop :=
  (∀ x y : X, g (x ⊓ y) ≤ g x → g y ≤ g (x ⊔ y)) ∧
    (∀ x y : X, g (x ⊓ y) < g x → g y < g (x ⊔ y))

/-- Anchor/sanity reduction: the constant objective reduces
quasi-supermodularity to `True`. -/
theorem anchor_QuasiSupermodular_const_iff
    {X α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] [Preorder α] (a : α) :
    QuasiSupermodular (fun _ : X => a) ↔ True := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    trivial
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro x y hle
      exact le_rfl
    · intro x y hlt
      exact hlt

theorem quasiSupermodular_const
    {X α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] [Preorder α] (a : α) :
    QuasiSupermodular (fun _ : X => a) :=
  (anchor_QuasiSupermodular_const_iff (X := X) a).mpr trivial

/-- Cardinal supermodularity is a sufficient condition for ordinal
quasi-supermodularity over real-valued objectives. -/
theorem cardinalSupermodular_to_quasiSupermodular
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] {g : X → ℝ}
    (h_super : ∀ x y : X, g x + g y ≤ g (x ⊔ y) + g (x ⊓ y)) :
    QuasiSupermodular g := by
  constructor
  · intro x y hle
    have h := h_super x y
    linarith
  · intro x y hlt
    have h := h_super x y
    linarith

/-- A choice globally maximizes an objective. -/
def IsGlobalMax {X α : Type*} [Preorder α] (g : X → α) (x : X) : Prop :=
  ∀ y : X, g y ≤ g x

/-- Anchor: global maximizers are exactly Mathlib greatest elements of the
range of objective values. -/
theorem anchor_IsGlobalMax_agrees_IsGreatest_range
    {X α : Type*} [Preorder α] (g : X → α) (x : X) :
    IsGlobalMax g x ↔ IsGreatest (Set.range g) (g x) := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨⟨x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact hx y
  · intro hx y
    exact hx.2 ⟨y, rfl⟩

/-- The set of global maximizers. -/
def ArgmaxSet {X α : Type*} [Preorder α] (g : X → α) : Set X :=
  {x | IsGlobalMax g x}

theorem mem_argmaxSet
    {X α : Type*} [Preorder α] (g : X → α) (x : X) :
    x ∈ ArgmaxSet g ↔ IsGlobalMax g x := by
  rfl

    {X α : Type*} [Preorder α] (a : α) :
    ArgmaxSet (fun _ : X => a) = Set.univ := by
  ext x
  simp [ArgmaxSet, IsGlobalMax]

/-- The argmax correspondence of a parametric objective. -/
def ParametricArgmaxSet
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder α] (f : X → T → α) (t : T) : Set X :=
  ArgmaxSet (fun x : X => f x t)

/-- Anchor: the parametric argmax set is the argmax set of the parameter
section. -/

    ParametricArgmaxSet (fun _ : X => fun _ : T => a) t = Set.univ := by
  exact argmaxSet_const_eq_univ a

structure HasMaximizerAt
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder α] (f : X → T → α) (t : T) where
  point : X

/-- Strong set order (Veinott order) on sets in a lattice. -/
def StrongSetLE
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] (A B : Set X) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ B → x ⊓ y ∈ A ∧ x ⊔ y ∈ B

-- @vacuity-scope: StrongSetLE: if either side is empty, the universal
-- membership condition can be vacuous.  For argmax correspondences use
-- `ParametricArgmaxNonempty` or the witness lemmas below.

/-- Anchor: on singleton sets, the strong set order reduces to the underlying
Mathlib element order. -/
theorem anchor_StrongSetLE_singletons_iff

  constructor

    have hpair := h (by simp : a ∈ ({a} : Set X)) (by simp : b ∈ ({b} : Set X))
    have hjoin : a ⊔ b = b := by
      simpa using hpair.2
    exact sup_eq_right.mp hjoin
  · intro hab x y hx hy
    have hx' : x = a := by simpa using hx
    have hy' : y = b := by simpa using hy
    subst x
    subst y
    constructor
    · simp [inf_eq_left.mpr hab]
    · simp [sup_eq_right.mpr hab]

/-- A set is closed under the lattice meet and join operations. -/
def IsSublatticeSet
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] (A : Set X) : Prop :=
  (∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ A → x ⊓ y ∈ A) ∧
    (∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ A → x ⊔ y ∈ A)

theorem strongSetLE_univ
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] :
    StrongSetLE (Set.univ : Set X) (Set.univ : Set X) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  exact ⟨trivial, trivial⟩

/-- A correspondence is nondecreasing in the strong set order. -/
def StrongSetMonotone
    {X T : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] [Preorder T]
    (G : T → Set X) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃t t' : T⦄, t ≤ t' → StrongSetLE (G t) (G t')

/-- Strict ordinal single crossing: strict preference for the higher choice is
preserved as the parameter rises.  This is the missing strict half in the
Milgrom--Shannon ordinal condition. -/

    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]

/-- Strong set order (Veinott order) on sets in a lattice. -/
def StrongSetLE
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] (A B : Set X) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ B → x ⊓ y ∈ A ∧ x ⊔ y ∈ B

  constructor
  · intro h
    have hpair := h (by simp : a ∈ ({a} : Set X)) (by simp : b ∈ ({b} : Set X))
    have hjoin : a ⊔ b = b := by
      simpa using hpair.2
    exact sup_eq_right.mp hjoin
  · intro hab x y hx hy
    have hx' : x = a := by simpa using hx
    have hy' : y = b := by simpa using hy
    subst x
    subst y
    constructor
    · simp [inf_eq_left.mpr hab]
    · simp [sup_eq_right.mpr hab]

/-- A set is closed under the lattice meet and join operations. -/
def IsSublatticeSet
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] (A : Set X) : Prop :=
  (∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ A → x ⊓ y ∈ A) ∧
    (∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ A → x ⊔ y ∈ A)

theorem strongSetLE_univ
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] :
    StrongSetLE (Set.univ : Set X) (Set.univ : Set X) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  exact ⟨trivial, trivial⟩

/-- A correspondence is nondecreasing in the strong set order. -/
def StrongSetMonotone
    {X T : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] [Preorder T]
    (G : T → Set X) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃t t' : T⦄, t ≤ t' → StrongSetLE (G t) (G t')

    StrongSetMonotone (fun _ : T => (Set.univ : Set X)) := by
  intro t t' htt'

/-- Strict ordinal single crossing: strict preference for the higher choice is
preserved as the parameter rises.  This is the missing strict half in the
Milgrom--Shannon ordinal condition. -/
def OrdinalStrictSingleCrossing
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]
    (f : X → T → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄ ⦃t t' : T⦄,
    x ≤ x' → t ≤ t' → f x t < f x' t → f x t' < f x' t'

/-- Full ordinal single crossing: both weak and strict crossings are preserved.
This is the workable ordinal complementarity substrate for nonunique Topkis
monotonicity with quasi-supermodularity. -/

    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]
    (f : X → T → α) : Prop :=
  OrdinalSingleCrossing f ∧ OrdinalStrictSingleCrossing f

  constructor
  · intro h

    · intro x x' hxx' t t' htt' ht

    constructor

cardinal: it is stated only in terms of order comparisons of objective values.

/-- Cardinal increasing differences, retained as a sufficient condition for the
ordinal single-crossing primitive. -/
def IncreasingDifferences

  ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄ ⦃t t' : T⦄,

/-- Ordinal single crossing: if the higher choice is weakly better at a lower
parameter, it remains weakly better at any higher parameter. -/
def OrdinalSingleCrossing
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]
    (f : X → T → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄ ⦃t t' : T⦄,
    x ≤ x' → t ≤ t' → f x t ≤ f x' t → f x t' ≤ f x' t'

the parameter set where the higher choice is weakly preferred is a Mathlib

  · intro h x x' t t' hxx' htt' ht

for real-valued objectives. -/

join optimality; the strict implication rules out losing optimality at the

def QuasiSupermodular

    · intro x y hlt

* Single crossing candidate B, real-valued increasing differences, is retained

/-- Cardinal increasing differences, retained as a sufficient condition for the

  ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄ ⦃t t' : T⦄,
    x ≤ x' → t ≤ t' → f x' t - f x t ≤ f x' t' - f x t'

/-- Ordinal single crossing: if the higher choice is weakly better at a lower
parameter, it remains weakly better at any higher parameter. -/
def OrdinalSingleCrossing
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]
    (f : X → T → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄ ⦃t t' : T⦄,
    x ≤ x' → t ≤ t' → f x t ≤ f x' t → f x t' ≤ f x' t'

abbrev ClaimSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

abbrev PaymentSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=

    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=

    (pool ≤ (∑ i, claims i) ∧ (∑ i, pay i) = pool)

    rw [min_eq_right hp, hpx, min_eq_left (zero_le y), min_eq_left (le_add_right hp)]

import Mathlib

abbrev ClaimSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

                                                                    

abbrev PaymentSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

                                                                           

def DistributionFeasible {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : ι, pay i ≤ claims i) ∧ (∑ i, pay i) ≤ pool

                                                                           
             

def AbsolutePriority {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  ∀ senior junior : ι, senior < junior → 0 < pay junior → pay senior = claims senior

                                                                      
                            

def APRTriggered {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  ∃ senior junior : ι, senior < junior ∧ 0 < pay junior

                                                                              
                           

structure NonvacuousAbsolutePriority {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop where
  apr : AbsolutePriority claims pay
  triggered : APRTriggered pay

                                                                                 

noncomputable def SeniorClaimsBefore {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (i : ι) : NNReal := by
  classical
  exact ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < i), claims j

                                                                              
                                            

noncomputable def WaterfallDistribution {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) : PaymentSchedule ι :=
  fun i => min (claims i) (pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims i)

                                                                             
                 

structure WaterfallConclusion {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop where
  feasible : DistributionFeasible claims pool pay
  absolute_priority : AbsolutePriority claims pay

    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=

  ∃ senior junior : ι, senior < junior ∧ 0 < pay junior

condition. -/

/-- Anchor: APR is exactly the primitive senior-before-positive-junior

  exact ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < i), claims j

filtered set of strictly senior tranches. -/

  fun i => min (claims i) (pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims i)

    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (rank : ι → ℕ) (i : ι) :

    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (rank : ι → ℕ)

    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (rank : ι → ℕ)

    PariPassuLevelClaimTotal claims rank i = RankLevelClaim claims rank k := by
  classical
  simp [PariPassuLevelClaimTotal, RankLevelClaim, hik]

  classical

      min (pool - RankSeniorClaim claims rank k) (RankLevelClaim claims rank k) := by

  by_cases htot : RankLevelClaim claims rank k = 0
  · have hzero : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ι => rank i = k),

      intro i hi
      have hik : rank i = k := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
      simp [PariPassuWaterfallDistribution, PariPassuRankResidual,
        levelTotal_eq_rankLevel claims rank hik,
        seniorBefore_eq_rankSenior claims rank hik, htot]
    have hlevel :

      simp [htot]
    rw [hlevel]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero hzero

          PariPassuWaterfallDistribution claims rank pool i) =
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ι => rank i = k),

      intro i hi
      have hik : rank i = k := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
      simp [PariPassuWaterfallDistribution, PariPassuRankResidual,
        levelTotal_eq_rankLevel claims rank hik,
        seniorBefore_eq_rankSenior claims rank hik, htot]
    rw [hsum]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    have ht' :
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ι => rank i = k), claims i) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [RankLevelClaim] using htot

    rw [div_self ht', one_mul]

    min pool s + min (pool - s) c = min pool (s + c) := by
  by_cases hs : s ≤ pool
  · have hleft : min pool s = s := min_eq_right hs
    rw [hleft]
    by_cases hc : c ≤ pool - s
    · have hright1 : min (pool - s) c = c := min_eq_right hc
      have hsp : s + c ≤ pool := by
        have := (le_tsub_iff_right hs).1 hc
        simpa [add_comm] using this
      have hright2 : min pool (s + c) = s + c := min_eq_right hsp
      rw [hright1, hright2]
    · have hcp : pool - s ≤ c := le_of_not_ge hc
      have hright1 : min (pool - s) c = pool - s := min_eq_left hcp
      have hright2 : min pool (s + c) = pool := by
        apply min_eq_left
        calc
          pool = s + (pool - s) := by rw [add_tsub_cancel_of_le hs]
          _ ≤ s + c := by simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hcp s
      rw [hright1, hright2]
      rw [add_tsub_cancel_of_le hs]
  · have hps : pool ≤ s := le_of_not_ge hs
    have hleft : min pool s = pool := min_eq_left hps
    have hzero : pool - s = 0 := tsub_eq_zero_of_le hps
    have hright : min pool (s + c) = pool := by
      apply min_eq_left
      exact hps.trans (self_le_add_right s c)
    simp [hleft, hzero, hright]

  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
      exact nnreal_min_add_min_tsub pool (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, c k) (c n)

    intro i

    have hle : rank i ≤ (Finset.univ.image rank).sup (fun k : ℕ => k) := by

  calc

          intro k hk
          rw [sum_range_levelClaim_eq_senior claims rank k]

    _ ≤ pool := min_le_left _ _
